documentation_excerpts.text: > chDB is an in-process SQL OLAP Engine powered by ClickHouse [^1] > For more details: [The birth of chDB](https://auxten.com/the-birth-of-chdb/)

* **🐼 Pandas-compatible DataStore API** - Use familiar pandas syntax with ClickHouse performance * **🌐 Runs in the browser via WebAssembly** - [chDB-Wasm](https://github.com/chdb-io/chdb-wasm) compiles the full engine to WASM; try it live at [wasm.chdb.io](https://wasm.chdb.io) * In-process SQL OLAP Engine, powered by ClickHouse * No need to install ClickHouse * Minimized data copy from C++ to Python with [python memoryview](https://docs.python.org/3/c-api/memoryview.html) * Input&Output support
- 📖 Getting Started Tutorial — set up your first connection - 🚀 Extended 30-day Hex Trial — full access to ClickHouse integrations
